evals.name: ingest-and-compile-article
evals.prompt: 我最近在研究 transformer 架构的演进，刚读了一篇文章说 Google 的 Mixture of Experts (MoE) 在 2024 年的新变体实现了 3x 稀疏激活比。我想把这个加到我的知识库里。文章在我 evals/fixtures/raw/articles/moe-2024.md，帮我走一下完整的 ingest 和 compile 流程。
evals.expected_output: Wiki articles for the MoE concept, updated index, backlinks, and provenance

assertions.name: creates-wiki-article
assertions.text: A wiki article about MoE is created under wiki/articles/ or wiki/concepts/

assertions.name: creates-wiki-index
assertions.text: A wiki index or table of contents is created (wiki/index.md or equivalent)

assertions.name: uses-wiki-links
assertions.text: Articles use [[wiki-link]] syntax for cross-references

assertions.name: has-provenance
assertions.text: Wiki article links back to the raw source (moe-2024.md reference exists)

assertions.name: structured-frontmatter
assertions.text: Wiki article has YAML frontmatter with title and tags

evals.name: query-and-synthesize
evals.prompt: 我的知识库在 wiki/ 目录下，已经有一些关于 ML 架构的研究笔记了。帮我查一下：我目前的研究里，attention mechanism 和 mixture of experts 之间有什么联系？有没有已知的交叉工作？输出一份 markdown 报告到 outputs/reports/ 下，同时看看有没有需要补充的连接。
evals.expected_output: Synthesized report with citations to wiki pages, plus new connections added

assertions.name: creates-report
assertions.text: A markdown report is generated under outputs/reports/

assertions.name: has-citations
assertions.text: Report cites specific wiki pages or concepts

assertions.name: creates-outputs-dir
assertions.text: Outputs directory structure follows skill convention

assertions.name: adds-connections
assertions.text: New connections or gaps are identified

assertions.name: synthesized-answer
assertions.text: Report contains a synthesized answer, not just a list of sources

evals.name: generate-slides-from-wiki
evals.prompt: 帮我把 wiki 里关于 LLM 架构演变的研究整理成一个 Marp 幻灯片，放在 outputs/slides/ 下。大概 6-8 页，要有从 Transformer → MoE → 最新的趋势。如果 wiki/concepts/ 里有相关配图也嵌入进去。
evals.expected_output: Marp-format slide deck with 6-8 slides, cross-referencing wiki articles

assertions.name: creates-marp-file
assertions.text: A Marp slide file is created under outputs/slides/

assertions.name: has-marp-frontmatter
assertions.text: Slide file has marp: true frontmatter

assertions.name: has-slide-separators
assertions.text: Uses '---' slide separators (Marp format)

assertions.name: has-sufficient-slides
assertions.text: Has at least 5 slides

assertions.name: covers-transformer-to-moe
assertions.text: Covers both Transformer and MoE topics

evals.name: lint-health-check
evals.prompt: 跑一下我的 wiki 健康检查。看看有没有孤立页面、断裂的引用、不一致的数据，还有哪些值得写的新主题方向。给我一份检查报告。
evals.expected_output: Health check report with prioritized issues and suggestions

assertions.name: produces-lint-report
assertions.text: A lint/health check report is produced

assertions.name: identifies-orphans
assertions.text: Report checks for orphan pages

assertions.name: checks-references
assertions.text: Report checks for broken backlinks or references

assertions.name: has-recommendations
assertions.text: Report includes actionable recommendations

assertions.name: prioritized-fixes
assertions.text: Report has prioritized or categorized issue list
